name: Outdoor & Balcony Materials
tagline: Everything that has to survive sun, monsoon and neglect
description: Balconies and terraces are the most abused surfaces in an Indian home: forty degrees in May, standing water in July, and nobody maintains them. Everything specified here is chosen for UV stability, drainage and the ability to be left alone for a year.

materials.name: Outdoor tile
materials.blurb: UV-stable, frost-proof tile with a grip-rated face
materials.description: Thick porcelain bodies with an R10–R12 face, laid to a fall so water leaves the slab. 20 mm pavers can be dry-laid on pedestals, which keeps the waterproofing below untouched.

materials.name: Wooden decking
materials.blurb: Hardwood boards on joists — warm underfoot, needs oiling
materials.description: Ipe, teak or merbau laid on treated joists with a 5 mm gap for drainage. Oil it annually or accept the silver-grey weathered look, which many clients actually prefer.

materials.name: WPC decking
materials.blurb: Composite boards that never need oiling
materials.description: Wood-plastic composite planks with a co-extruded cap for UV and stain resistance. It will fade a little in the first season and then stay put for a decade with only a wash.

materials.name: Artificial grass
materials.blurb: UV-stable turf with a drainage backing
materials.description: 35–40 mm pile with a perforated backing over a screed laid to fall. Good turf has mixed blade colours and a thatch layer; cheap turf looks like a doormat within a year.

materials.name: Pergola
materials.blurb: Overhead frame in timber, aluminium or steel with a shade infill
materials.description: Turns an unusable sunlit terrace into a room. Aluminium louvred systems adjust to the sun and shed rain; timber looks better and needs maintenance. Check the parapet fixing and wind load.

materials.name: Outdoor lighting
materials.blurb: IP65+ fittings sized for rain, dust and coastal air
materials.description: Wall washers, bollards and step lights, all IP65 or better, with surge protection on the circuit. Near the sea, specify SS 316 or marine-grade coated bodies or expect rust within a year.

materials.name: Stone cladding (exterior)
materials.blurb: Weather-fast natural stone for façades and compound walls
materials.description: Sandstone, slate and granite strips fixed with adhesive plus mechanical anchors — adhesive alone will eventually let a panel go. Seal it if efflorescence is a risk.

materials.name: Exterior paint
materials.blurb: Weatherproof emulsion with a warranted life
materials.description: Acrylic or silicone-modified exteriors carrying a 5–10 year warranty, over an exterior primer on a properly cured surface. Most exterior paint failures are surface preparation, not paint.

materials.name: Terrace waterproofing
materials.blurb: The membrane and screed system that keeps the slab dry
materials.description: Liquid-applied PU or APP membrane, protected by a screed laid to fall, with upstands at every parapet and drain. Pond-test before anything is laid over it — after that it is too late.

materials.name: Outdoor furniture (weatherproof)
materials.blurb: Aluminium, teak or synthetic rattan built to be left out
materials.description: Powder-coated aluminium or teak frames with solution-dyed acrylic cushions. Anything with mild steel or standard foam will not survive one Indian monsoon on an open terrace.
